record.field: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice date. Please ensure timely payment to avoid late fees. For any payment-related queries, contact our finance department.
Estimated delivery is 5-7 business days from order confirmation. Delivery times may vary depending on location and product availability. You will be notified once the order is dispatched.

All products come with a 12-month warranty from the date of purchase. Returns are accepted within 14 days in original condition with proof of purchase. Contact us to initiate a return or warranty claim.
Thank you for your order! We appreciate your business and look forward to serving you again. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

All received goods are subject to quality inspection upon arrival. Please ensure items match the specifications stated in the purchase order. Discrepancies must be reported within 3 business days of delivery.

Please submit your invoice referencing the Purchase Order number. Invoices without a valid PO number will not be processed. Payment will be made within the agreed credit terms upon receipt of a valid invoice.
Please confirm the delivery schedule at least 48 hours before dispatch. Deliveries must be made during business hours (Mon-Fri, 8AM-5PM). Contact our warehouse team to arrange an appointment.

This document and its contents are confidential and intended solely for the named recipient. Unauthorized disclosure, copying, or distribution is strictly prohibited. If received in error, please notify us immediately.

This transaction is subject to our standard terms and conditions. By proceeding, both parties agree to comply with the terms outlined in the signed agreement. A copy of our full terms is available upon request.
For any inquiries regarding this document, please contact our team during business hours (Mon-Fri, 8AM-5PM). We aim to respond to all queries within 1 business day.
